items.title: Physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access in a referral-based system in Austria - A qualitative study.
items.summary: A qualitative study in Austria explored physiotherapists' perspectives on direct access, revealing perceived readiness for triage roles despite lacking a legal framework, moderate-to-high confidence in differential diagnosis but lower in red-flag screening, and identified needs for targeted training and interprofessional collaboration.
items.curatedReason: 在奥地利这样的转诊制国家，物理治疗师普遍认为自己有能力提供直接评估和治疗，但仍需正式的法律框架和红旗征象筛查的培训。这提示直接准入在全球推行时，除了临床技能，配套的法律、责任和跨专业协作机制也是关键。
items.titleZh: 奥地利转诊制下物理治疗师对直接准入的看法：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项在奥地利进行的定性研究探讨了物理治疗师对直接准入的看法。结果显示，物理治疗师普遍认为自己已在非正式地进行直接准入的初级评估工作，但在鉴别诊断方面信心较高，在红旗征象筛查方面信心较低。研究强调了正式培训、跨专业合作和报销机制对于安全公平实施直接准入的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: In referral-based systems like Austria, physiotherapists feel competent for direct access but need formal legal frameworks and red-flag screening training. This highlights that successful global direct access implementation requires not just clinical skills, but also supportive legal, liability, and interprofessional collaboration mechanisms.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性探索性研究，样本量小（10 名物理治疗师），结果可能不完全代表整个行业或推及其他地理区域。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative exploratory study with a small sample size (10 physiotherapists), so the findings may not be fully representative of the profession or generalizable to other geographic regions.

items.title: A normative torque-profile approach for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke: a proof-of-principle study
items.summary: This proof-of-principle study introduced ScoreE, an isokinetic dynamometry metric, to objectively quantify post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance in 35 patients. ScoreE demonstrated good to excellent inter-rater (ICC 0.81-0.89) and test-retest reliability (ICC 0.76-0.93), with moderate associations with Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS) grades, providing a reliable tool for longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究提出了一种新的等速测力学指标ScoreE，用于客观量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。该指标具有良好的评定者间和重测信度（ICC范围0.76-0.93），且与MAS量表评分中度相关。ScoreE为客观监测卒中痉挛和评估干预效果提供了一个有潜力的工具，有助于你更精准地评估患者进展。
items.titleZh: 一种量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗的常模扭矩-轮廓方法：一项概念验证研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项概念验证研究引入了等速测力学指标ScoreE，以客观量化35名卒中患者的肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。ScoreE表现出良好至卓越的评定者间（ICC 0.81-0.89）和重测信度（ICC 0.76-0.93），并与改良Ashworth量表（MAS）评分呈中度相关，为长期监测提供了一个可靠工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-principle study introduces ScoreE, a novel isokinetic dynamometry-derived metric for objectively quantifying post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance. The metric demonstrates good to excellent inter-rater and test-retest reliability (ICC range 0.76-0.93) and moderate associations with MAS grades. ScoreE offers a promising tool for objectively monitoring stroke spasticity and evaluating intervention effects, helping you more precisely assess patient progress.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（35名卒中患者），且对振动干预后的反应性评估为探索性，未进行正式评估，需更大规模研究验证其临床敏感性和响应性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (35 stroke patients), and the responsiveness to vibration intervention was exploratory without formal assessment, requiring larger studies to validate clinical sensitivity and responsiveness.

items.title: Blood flow restriction with different loads versus moderate intensity resistive exercises in patients with knee osteoarthritis: a single-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A single-blind RCT (n=75) on knee osteoarthritis patients compared passive blood flow restriction (BFR) at 50% and 70% limb occlusion pressure (LOP) with moderate-intensity resistance training (MI-RT). MI-RT yielded greater quadriceps strength. BFR-70% LOP significantly improved lower-extremity functional ability with less perceived exertion, while BFR-50% LOP showed smaller improvements.
items.curatedReason: 如果膝关节骨关节炎患者无法耐受常规中等强度阻力训练，那么 70% 肢体血流阻断压下的被动血流限制训练值得考虑。这项 RCT 表明，它能有效改善下肢功能，且患者感知劳累程度较低，优于 50% LOP，但对股四头肌力量的提升不如中等强度阻力训练。
items.titleZh: 膝骨关节炎患者的血流限制联合不同负荷与中等强度阻力训练的比较：一项单盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对膝骨关节炎患者的单盲随机对照试验（75 例），比较了 50% 和 70% 肢体血流阻断压（LOP）下的被动血流限制（BFR）与中等强度阻力训练（MI-RT）。MI-RT 产生了更大的股四头肌力量增益。70% LOP 的 BFR 显著改善了下肢功能能力，且感知劳累较低，而 50% LOP 的 BFR 改善较小。
items.curatedReasonEn: Consider passive blood flow restriction at 70% limb occlusion pressure for knee OA patients who cannot tolerate conventional moderate-intensity resistance training. This RCT shows it significantly improves lower-extremity function with less perceived exertion, outperforming 50% LOP, though it yields less quadriceps strength gain than MI-RT.
items.limitation: 本研究为单盲设计，无法排除研究者偏倚对结果的影响，且未提供长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: This study is single-blinded, so researcher bias cannot be excluded, and long-term follow-up data are not provided.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Trajectories of physical activity following digital education and exercise therapy—a longitudinal registry study among 15,197 persons with knee or hip osteoarthritis
items.summary: A longitudinal registry study (n=15,197) of knee/hip osteoarthritis patients receiving digital education and exercise therapy found the proportion meeting recommended physical activity (PA) levels increased from 51.4% to 58.5% at one year. Four PA trajectories were identified (persistently high 41.2%, persistently low 30.4%, increasing 16.5%, declining 11.9%), with BMI and physical function being key associated factors. All trajectories showed comparable improvements in patient-reported outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项大样本纵向研究显示，数字化教育与运动疗法能有效提升膝/髋骨关节炎患者的体力活动水平，近六成患者达到或维持了推荐的活动量。这提示你，即使患者基线体力活动水平不高，这种干预模式也值得推荐，尤其要关注 BMI 较高和功能较差的患者。
items.titleZh: 数字化教育和运动疗法后体力活动轨迹：一项针对 15,197 名膝关节或髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 15,197 名膝/髋关节骨关节炎患者的纵向注册研究发现，接受数字化教育和运动疗法后，达到推荐体力活动（PA）水平的患者比例在一年内从 51.4% 增至 58.5%。研究识别出四种 PA 轨迹（持续高水平 41.2%，持续低水平 30.4%，增长型 16.5%，下降型 11.9%），其中 BMI 和身体功能是主要相关因素。所有轨迹的患者报告结局都有可比的改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large-sample longitudinal study shows that digital education and exercise therapy can effectively increase physical activity levels in knee/hip osteoarthritis patients, with nearly 60% reaching or maintaining recommended activity levels. This suggests that this intervention model is worthwhile, even for patients with low baseline physical activity, especially those with higher BMI and poorer function.
items.limitation: 该研究基于注册数据，可能存在数据报告偏倚，且未提供关于干预具体内容和依从性的详细信息。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on registry data, which may involve reporting bias, and lacks detailed information on the specific intervention content and adherence.

items.title: Exercise prioritization in frailty: a pathophysiology-informed narrative review for rehabilitation in older adults
items.summary: This narrative review proposes a pathophysiology-informed framework for prioritizing exercise in frail older adults. It suggests tailoring interventions based on dominant physiological limitations (e.g., resistance training for weakness, aerobic training for dyspnea, balance training for gait instability), with multicomponent exercise as a default. Formal validation of this treatment-matching algorithm is needed.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述提出了衰弱老年人康复中运动干预的病理生理学导向优先级框架。它提示你，在制定干预方案时，应根据患者最主要的生理储备限制（如肌力不足、呼吸困难或步态不稳）来调整运动类型，确保个性化治疗。
items.titleZh: 衰弱中的运动优先级：一项基于病理生理学的叙述性综述，旨在指导老年人康复。
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述提出了一个基于病理生理学的框架，用于确定衰弱老年人运动的优先级。它建议根据主要的生理限制（例如，针对虚弱进行阻力训练，针对呼吸困难进行有氧训练，针对步态不稳进行平衡训练）来调整干预措施，并将多组分运动作为默认方案。该治疗匹配算法的正式验证仍是下一步研究方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review proposes a pathophysiology-informed prioritization framework for exercise interventions in frail older adults. It suggests that when designing intervention programs, you should tailor exercise types based on the patient's most dominant physiological reserve limitations (e.g., muscle weakness, breathlessness, or gait instability) to ensure personalized treatment.
items.limitation: 本研究为叙述性综述，证据主要来自衰弱队列、肌少症试验及其他老年运动研究的推断，缺乏直接的瓶颈匹配处方对比试验，结论仍需正式验证。
items.limitationEn: This narrative review's evidence primarily extrapolates from frail cohorts, sarcopenia trials, and other older adult exercise studies, lacking direct trials of bottleneck-matched prescriptions, so conclusions require formal validation.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Physical and mental health outcomes of organized sports participation in adult women: a systematic review and meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis (16 studies, n=6,271 women) found that organized sports participation significantly improved VO₂peak (MD = 1.51), reduced depression (MD = -5.30), increased social capital (MD = +7.30), reduced fat mass (MD = -1.14 kg), and increased lean mass (MD = 0.90 kg) in adult women. Benefits extended to bone formation, occupational functioning, and social connectedness.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析坐实了参与有组织的体育运动能显著改善成年女性的体能、心理健康和生活质量，且其社会和结构维度放大了非结构性运动的益处。在推广女性健康和康复时，你应积极整合有组织的体育活动。
items.titleZh: 成年女性参与有组织的体育运动对身心健康的影响：一项系统综述和荟萃分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述和荟萃分析（16 项研究，6,271 名女性）发现，成年女性参与有组织的体育运动显著改善了最大摄氧量（平均差 = 1.51），降低了抑郁（平均差 = -5.30），增加了社会资本（平均差 = +7.30），减少了脂肪量（平均差 = -1.14 公斤），并增加了瘦体重（平均差 = 0.90 公斤）。益处还扩展到骨骼形成、职业功能和社会联系。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 6,271 women confirms that organized sports are a potent, multidimensional intervention for adult women's health. Not only does it significantly improve VO₂peak (MD = 1.51) and reduce depression (MD = -5.30), but its social and structural dimensions amplify benefits. You should actively recommend and integrate organized sports into women's health and rehabilitation promotion.
items.limitation: 本系统综述和荟萃分析纳入的 RCT 存在低至中度的内部效度风险，非随机设计存在高偏倚风险，这可能影响证据的整体强度。
items.limitationEn: This systematic review and meta-analysis include RCTs with low to moderate risk of internal validity and non-randomized designs with high risk of bias, which may affect the overall strength of the evidence.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: The effect of empowerment based on 5 A model on fall self-efficacy, self-care and quality of life in older adults: a parallel randomized clinical trial
items.summary: A parallel randomized clinical trial (n=110 older adults) found that a 12-week empowerment intervention based on the 5A model significantly improved fall self-efficacy (p < 0.001), self-care (p < 0.001), and quality of life (p < 0.001) in the intervention group compared to routine care. The mean age of participants was 68.28 ± 3.14 years.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 显示，基于 5A 模型的赋能干预显著提升了老年人的跌倒自我效能、自我护理能力和生活质量。这提示你在制定老年跌倒预防和健康促进方案时，可以积极采用这种赋能模式。
items.titleZh: 基于 5A 模型的赋能干预对老年人跌倒自我效能、自我护理和生活质量的影响：一项平行随机临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项平行随机临床试验（110 名老年人）发现，与常规护理相比，基于 5A 模型的 12 周赋能干预显著改善了干预组的跌倒自我效能（p < 0.001）、自我护理（p < 0.001）和生活质量（p < 0.001）。参与者的平均年龄为 68.28 ± 3.14 岁。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT shows that an empowerment intervention based on the 5A model significantly improved fall self-efficacy, self-care, and quality of life in older adults. This suggests you can actively adopt this empowerment model when developing fall prevention and health promotion programs for the elderly.
items.limitation: 本研究为单中心试验，结果在不同文化背景和医疗系统下的普适性可能需要进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: This is a single-center trial, and the generalizability of its findings to different cultural backgrounds and healthcare systems may require further validation.

items.title: A 10-week randomized controlled hip-strengthening intervention in healthy, well-trained runners: longitudinal and cross-sectional analyses of frontal-plane running biomechanics across running speeds
items.summary: A 10-week RCT (n=48) in healthy, trained runners found that a hip-strengthening intervention improved hip abductor strength (0.20–0.29 Nm/kg) but did not alter frontal-plane running biomechanics (e.g., knee abduction moments). Greater hip abductor strength was associated with higher knee abduction moments only at slow running speeds at baseline.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 表明，对健康训练有素的跑者进行 10 周的臀部肌力强化，尽管能提高肌力，但并未显著改变跑步时的额状面生物力学。在制定跑步损伤预防方案时，不要高估臀部肌力训练对额状面生物力学的直接影响。
items.titleZh: 对健康、训练有素的跑者进行 10 周随机对照髋部强化干预：不同跑步速度下额状面跑步生物力学的纵向和横断面分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康、训练有素跑者的 10 周随机对照试验（48 例）发现，髋部强化干预提高了髋外展肌力量（0.20–0.29 Nm/kg），但并未改变额状面跑步生物力学（如膝关节外展力矩）。基线时，只有在慢速跑步时，较高的髋外展肌力量才与较高的膝关节外展力矩相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT indicates that 10 weeks of hip strengthening in healthy, well-trained runners, despite improving strength, did not significantly alter frontal-plane running biomechanics. When developing running injury prevention programs, do not overstate the direct impact of hip strengthening on frontal-plane biomechanics.
items.limitation: 本研究仅针对健康、训练有素的跑者，结果可能不适用于存在跑步相关损伤或体能水平较低的人群。
items.limitationEn: This study focused only on healthy, well-trained runners, so the results may not be applicable to individuals with running-related injuries or lower fitness levels.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Directional EMG patterns reveal impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke
items.summary: An exploratory study (n=8 chronic stroke survivors) using directional EMG mapping found that severely impaired participants exhibited restricted upper-limb force generation in lateral directions and narrow medial activation tuning, correlated with larger angular errors. Force demands and task direction modulated these deficits, suggesting patient-specific vulnerable zones and enhanced shoulder-driven control strategies.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究通过定向肌电图揭示了卒中后上肢力量控制的损伤相关性改变，尤其在重度受损患者中存在方向性限制和代偿策略。这提示你在设计个性化康复干预时，应考虑患者特定的“脆弱区域”和力/方向的复杂交互作用。
items.titleZh: 定向肌电图模式揭示卒中后上肢力量控制的损伤相关性破坏。
items.summaryZh: 一项使用定向肌电图映射的探索性研究（8 名慢性卒中幸存者）发现，重度受损的参与者在侧向力产生和内侧激活调谐方面表现出受限，这与更大的角度误差相关。力的需求和任务方向调节了这些缺陷，提示存在患者特定的脆弱区域和增强的肩驱动控制策略。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study, using directional EMG, reveals impairment-related disruptions in upper-limb force control after stroke, particularly directional limitations and compensatory strategies in severely impaired individuals. This suggests that when designing personalized rehabilitation interventions, you should consider patient-specific "vulnerable zones" and the complex interplay of force and direction.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（8 名慢性卒中幸存者），且缺乏对照组，无法确立干预措施的有效性，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (8 chronic stroke survivors) and lacks a control group, making it unable to establish intervention efficacy and limiting generalizability.

items.title: Exercise interventions for gait and balance performances among older adults with sarcopenic obesity: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (13 studies, n=502) on exercise interventions for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity found exercise training (power, resistance, multicomponent) improved gait speed, step length, functional mobility, static balance, and postural control, with mild adverse effects. Most studies (nearly 70%) were on older women, limiting generalizability to older men.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，运动训练对肌少性肥胖老年人的步态和平衡表现有潜在益处。在为这类患者设计康复方案时，可优先考虑力量训练、有氧训练及多组分训练，但需注意现有研究多集中于老年女性，对老年男性的普适性仍待进一步证实。
items.titleZh: 肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡表现的运动干预：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡运动干预的范围综述（13 项研究，502 例）发现，运动训练（力量、阻力、多组分）改善了步态速度、步长、功能活动度、静态平衡和姿势控制，且不良反应轻微。大多数研究（近 70%）针对老年女性，限制了结果对老年男性的普适性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates potential benefits of exercise training for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity. When designing rehabilitation programs for this population, prioritize power, resistance, and multicomponent training, but be aware that current research primarily focuses on older women, and generalizability to older men needs further confirmation.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，纳入的 13 项研究中近 70% 仅针对老年女性，因此结果对老年男性的普适性存疑。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review includes 13 studies, nearly 70% of which focused solely on older women, raising questions about the generalizability of the findings to older men.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Effect of mesenchymal stem cell-Derived secretome injection on functional outcomes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction using peroneus longus tendon autograft: a double-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A double-blind RCT (n=24) comparing ACL reconstruction with peroneus longus tendon autograft with or without mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-derived secretome injection found the secretome group had significantly higher IKDC (86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01) and Tegner–Lysholm scores (87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01) at six months post-op. No major adverse events were reported.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，在 ACL 重建手术中辅助注射 MSC 衍生的分泌组可提高 6 个月后的患者报告膝关节功能评分。尽管结果积极，但样本量小，且仅为短期功能结局，尚不能将其作为常规临床实践，应等待更大样本和长期随访的研究结果。
items.titleZh: 间充质干细胞分泌组注射对腓骨长肌腱自体移植物前交叉韧带重建术后功能结局的影响：一项双盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验（24 例）比较了采用腓骨长肌腱自体移植物进行前交叉韧带（ACL）重建术后是否辅助注射间充质干细胞（MSC）分泌组。结果显示，分泌组在术后 6 个月时 IKDC 评分（86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01）和 Tegner–Lysholm 评分（87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01）显著更高。未报告主要不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample RCT suggests that adjunctive injection of MSC-derived secretome during ACL reconstruction may improve patient-reported knee function scores at 6 months. While positive, the small sample size and short-term functional outcomes mean it cannot be adopted as routine clinical practice yet; larger trials with long-term follow-up are needed.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量非常小（24 名参与者），随访期仅为 6 个月，且关注的是患者报告结局而非生物学愈合指标，结果的长期有效性和生物学机制仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: This study has a very small sample size (24 participants) and a follow-up period of only 6 months. It focuses on patient-reported outcomes rather than biological healing markers, so the long-term efficacy and biological mechanisms require further investigation.

items.title: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (21 studies) mapped evidence on whole-body vibration (WBV) and lumbar stabilization exercises (LSE) for postural control in flexible flatfoot (FF). It found very limited direct evidence for WBV or LSE specifically in FF, with most insights derived from related populations. The effectiveness and safety of these interventions in FF remain uncertain, highlighting a need for RCTs.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者步态控制的证据极为有限，现有证据多来自相关人群。在临床实践中，若无针对柔性扁平足的直接 RCT 证据，应谨慎应用这些干预措施。
items.titleZh: 全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者姿势控制的影响：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述（21 项研究）梳理了全身振动（WBV）和腰部稳定训练（LSE）对柔性扁平足（FF）患者姿势控制的证据。研究发现，针对 FF 的 WBV 或 LSE 直接证据非常有限，多数见解来自相关人群。这些干预措施在 FF 患者中的有效性和安全性仍不确定，亟需随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates extremely limited evidence for whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises improving postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot, with most existing evidence from related populations. In clinical practice, apply these interventions cautiously without direct RCT evidence for flexible flatfoot.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，主要旨在识别研究空白，而非评估干预措施的有效性，且纳入的大多数证据来自与柔性扁平足相关的其他人群。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review primarily aims to identify research gaps rather than evaluate intervention effectiveness, and most included evidence is from populations related to flexible flatfoot.

items.title: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study.
items.summary: A longitudinal study of traumatic spinal cord injury patients indicated that lower and declining social integration were associated with increased all-cause and cause-specific mortality, though causality could not be established due to study limitations.
items.curatedReason: 脊髓损伤后，社交越孤立、越退步，死亡风险越高，但这只是相关性，别当因果关系去治。
items.titleZh: 创伤性脊髓损伤后随时间变化的社会融合与全因及特定原因死亡率：一项纵向 SCIMS 研究
items.titleEn: Time-Varying Social Integration and Long-Term All-Cause and Cause-Specific Mortality After Traumatic Spinal Cord Injury: A Longitudinal SCIMS Study.
items.summaryZh: 一项针对创伤性脊髓损伤患者的纵向研究表明，社会融合度降低和下降与全因及特定原因死亡率增加相关，但研究局限性（如幸存者选择、遗漏死因和残余混杂）限制了因果关系的确定。
items.curatedReasonEn: This longitudinal study suggests that lower and declining social integration are associated with increased mortality after traumatic spinal cord injury. However, it notes that these findings do not establish a causal link and are limited by survivor selection and residual confounding.
items.limitation: The study cannot establish causality, and limitations include survivor selection, missing causes of death, and residual confounding.
items.limitationEn: The study cannot establish causality, and limitations include survivor selection, missing causes of death, and residual confounding.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Extracting meaningful features from time series analysis of plasma analytes in clinical research
items.summary: This preprint investigates the use of time series analysis of plasma enzyme levels to assay sarcolemma fragility and skeletal muscle damage, proposing it offers greater diagnostic value than absolute biomarker concentrations.
items.curatedReason: 这项预印本研究认为，通过分析血浆酶水平的时间序列，比测量绝对生物标志物浓度更能评估肌细胞膜脆性和骨骼肌损伤。
items.titleZh: 从血浆分析物时间序列分析中提取有意义的特征用于临床研究
items.titleEn: Extracting meaningful features from time series analysis of plasma analytes in clinical research
items.summaryZh: 这篇预印本研究了使用血浆酶水平的时间序列分析来检测肌细胞膜的脆弱性和骨骼肌损伤，并提出这种方法可能比绝对生物标志物浓度具有更高的诊断价值。
items.curatedReasonEn: This preprint explores using time series analysis of plasma analytes to assess sarcolemma fragility and skeletal muscle damage, suggesting this approach may provide more diagnostic value than absolute biomarker levels.
items.limitation: This is a preprint and has not yet been peer-reviewed. The study focused on specific patient populations and did not observe an extended post-injury rising phase of enzyme levels.
items.limitationEn: This is a preprint and has not yet been peer-reviewed. The study focused on specific patient populations and did not observe an extended post-injury rising phase of enzyme levels.

items.title: How does pre-stroke physical activity influence physical activity one year after minor stroke, and what role does cognitive impairment play?
items.summary: A secondary analysis of 100 minor stroke patients found that low pre-stroke physical activity was associated with higher odds of low physical activity 12 months post-stroke (OR=5.81, 95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p=0.010), suggesting its utility in identifying at-risk patients.
items.curatedReason: 卒中前活动量低的患者，卒中后 12 个月内持续不活跃的风险高（OR=5.81）。您在评估轻度卒中患者时，应将卒中前活动水平作为预测指标，用于识别高风险患者并尽早规划个性化康复干预。
items.titleZh: 卒中前体力活动如何影响轻度卒中后一年体力活动，以及认知障碍扮演的角色？
items.summaryZh: 对 100 名轻度卒中患者的二次分析发现，卒中前体力活动量低与卒中后 12 个月体力活动量低相关性较高（OR=5.81, 95% CI: 1.61-24.0, p=0.010），这表明其有助于识别高风险患者。
items.curatedReasonEn: Patients with low pre-stroke physical activity have higher odds (OR=5.81) of persistent inactivity 12 months post-stroke. When assessing patients with minor stroke, use pre-stroke activity levels as a predictor to identify high-risk individuals and initiate personalized rehabilitation early.
items.limitation: 本研究为回顾性队列分析，样本量较小（n=100），且认知障碍的调节作用尚无定论。
items.limitationEn: This is a retrospective cohort analysis with a small sample size (n=100), and the modifying role of cognitive impairment remains inconclusive.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD
items.summary: This study aims to evaluate the technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for COPD patients, including data transmission from connected devices and a home-based PR program, and explore clinical outcomes.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，将互联设备数据传输与居家肺康复（PR）相结合的远程康复模式，在 COPD 患者中具有技术和临床可行性。远程医疗是大势所趋，这一模式可能为患者提供更便捷的康复途径。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者肺部远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性。
items.summaryZh: 本研究旨在评估 COPD 患者肺部远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性，包括连接设备的数据传输和居家肺部康复计划，并探索临床结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that a pulmonary telerehabilitation model, combining connected device data transmission with home-based PR, is technically and clinically feasible for COPD patients. As telehealth expands, this model could offer a more accessible rehabilitation pathway for your patients.
items.limitation: 本研究主要关注技术和临床可行性，对具体临床结局的评估为探索性。
items.limitationEn: This study primarily focuses on technical and clinical feasibility, with an exploratory assessment of specific clinical outcomes.
items.journal: Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Digital therapeutic combining exercise and cognitive-behavioural therapy reduces pain in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain: a multicentre randomised controlled trial
items.summary: A multicenter randomized controlled trial found that a smartphone-based multidisciplinary intervention combining personalized exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy significantly improved pain, function, quality of life, and psychological well-being in patients with chronic patellofemoral pain. This digital therapeutic offers a scalable and cost-efficient delivery of care aligned with clinical guidelines.
items.curatedReason: 这款数字疗法结合了运动和认知行为疗法，在缓解慢性髌股疼痛方面效果显著。这提示你，数字化、多学科的干预方案是解决患者依从性和心理社会因素的有效途径，值得在临床实践中关注并考虑采纳。
items.titleZh: 数字疗法结合运动和认知行为疗法可减轻慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛：一项多中心随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项多中心随机对照试验发现，结合个性化运动和认知行为疗法的智能手机数字多学科干预显著改善了慢性髌股疼痛患者的疼痛、功能、生活质量和心理健康。这种数字疗法提供了一种符合临床指南的可扩展且经济高效的护理模式。
items.curatedReasonEn: This digital therapeutic, combining exercise and cognitive-behavioral therapy, significantly reduces chronic patellofemoral pain. This suggests that digitized, multidisciplinary interventions effectively address patient adherence and psychosocial factors, making it a valuable approach to monitor and potentially integrate into your clinical practice.
items.limitation: 研究未明确长期随访结果，且患者对数字平台的依从性数据未充分披露。
items.limitationEn: The study did not explicitly state long-term follow-up results, and patient adherence data to the digital platform were not fully disclosed.

items.title: Transcutaneous Vagus Nerve Stimulation Improves Motor Function of Upper Extremity in Adults with Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial found that transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) combined with upper limb exercises led to significant improvements in Fugl-Meyer Assessment for Upper Extremity (FMA-UE: MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69) and shoulder/elbow muscle strength in chronic ischemic stroke patients compared to sham taVNS.
items.curatedReason: 经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）可能改善慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢运动功能和肌肉力量。但在推广此技术前，应注意其FMA-UE评分的临床最小重要差异（MCID）边界效应。
items.titleZh: 经皮迷走神经刺激改善慢性缺血性卒中成人上肢运动功能：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，与安慰剂组相比，经皮耳迷走神经刺激（taVNS）结合上肢运动能显著改善慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢Fugl-Meyer评估（FMA-UE: MD = 3.95, 95% CI 0.21-7.69）和肩肘肌肉力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: Transcutaneous auricular vagal nerve stimulation (taVNS) may improve upper-limb motor function and muscle strength in patients with chronic ischemic stroke. Before widely adopting this technique, be mindful of the marginal effect size compared to the minimal clinically important difference (MCID) for FMA-UE scores.
items.limitation: FMA-UE的95%置信区间低于报告的临床最小重要差异，提示临床意义可能有限。
items.limitationEn: The 95% CI for FMA-UE was below the reported minimal clinically important difference, suggesting potentially limited clinical relevance.

items.title: Graft type is not associated with revision ACL reconstruction in football players: a nationwide cohort analysis of subsequent ACL reconstructions
items.summary: A nationwide cohort analysis of more than 10 000 football players who underwent ACL reconstruction found that graft choice (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) was not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction among players who returned to competition, in either women or men.
items.curatedReason: 这项全国性队列研究表明，在重返赛场的足球运动员中，ACL重建的移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与再次ACL重建的风险无关。这意味着你在选择移植物时，可以更多地考虑患者特征和手术偏好，而不是过分担忧再损伤风险。
items.titleZh: 移植物类型与足球运动员的翻修性前交叉韧带重建无关：一项全国性队列分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对超过 10 000 名接受前交叉韧带（ACL）重建的足球运动员的全国性队列分析发现，对于重返赛场的运动员，移植物类型（腘绳肌腱、髌腱或股四头肌腱自体移植物）与再次ACL重建的风险无关，无论是男性还是女性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide cohort study indicates that graft type (hamstring, patellar tendon, or quadriceps tendon autograft) is not associated with the risk of revision ACL reconstruction in football players who return to competition. This means you can prioritize patient characteristics and surgeon preference when selecting grafts, rather than overemphasizing reinjury risk.
items.limitation: 研究关注的是“再次ACL重建”而非“再次ACL损伤”，可能低估了实际的再损伤率。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on "revision ACL reconstruction" rather than "subsequent ACL injury," which might underestimate the actual reinjury rate.

items.title: Bothersome and activity-limiting pain in community-dwelling older adults with versus without stroke: a cross-sectional analysis of the National Health and Aging Trends study (2011-2024).
items.summary: A cross-sectional analysis of 12,797 older adults (2011-2024 NHATS data) found that those with a history of stroke had a higher prevalence of bothersome pain (60.77% vs. 54.66%) and activity-limiting pain (62.83% vs. 52.00%). Stroke was independently associated with both outcomes (OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66 for bothersome pain; OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38 for activity-limiting pain) after adjustment.
items.curatedReason: 有卒中史的老年社区居民报告困扰性疼痛和活动受限性疼痛的比例显著高于无卒中史者，且这种关联独立于其他因素。这提醒你对卒中患者的疼痛评估和管理应作为康复的重要组成部分。
items.titleZh: 伴或不伴卒中史的社区居住老年人中困扰性与活动受限性疼痛：对国家健康与老龄化趋势研究（2011-2024）的横断面分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对12,797名老年人（2011-2024年NHATS数据）的横断面分析显示，有卒中史者报告困扰性疼痛（60.77% vs 54.66%）和活动受限性疼痛（62.83% vs 52.00%）的患病率更高。在调整其他因素后，卒中与这两种疼痛结局独立相关（困扰性疼痛OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.02-1.66；活动受限性疼痛OR 1.20, 95% CI 1.04-1.38）。
items.curatedReasonEn: Community-dwelling older adults with a history of stroke report significantly higher rates of bothersome and activity-limiting pain, independent of other factors. This highlights the importance of comprehensive pain assessment and management as a crucial component of stroke rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立卒中与疼痛之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish a causal relationship between stroke and pain.

items.title: Maternal and fetal cardiovascular response to moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise in singleton and twin pregnancies
items.summary: This study investigated maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses to a submaximal graded cycling exercise test up to vigorous intensity in singleton and twin pregnancies. It found that the exercise was well tolerated by both mothers and fetuses, with few differences in responses between twin and singleton gestations.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了高质量证据，表明中等到剧烈强度运动对单胎和双胎妊娠的母胎心血管反应相似且耐受良好。这为你向双胎妊娠患者提供运动建议提供了更坚实的依据。
items.titleZh: 单胎和双胎妊娠中中度至剧烈强度运动对母胎心血管反应的影响
items.summaryZh: 本研究调查了中度至剧烈强度分级自行车运动对单胎和双胎妊娠母胎心血管反应的影响。结果显示，母亲和胎儿对运动的耐受性良好，双胎和单胎妊娠的反应差异很小。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides high-quality evidence that moderate-to-vigorous intensity exercise elicits similar and well-tolerated maternal and fetal cardiovascular responses in both singleton and twin pregnancies. This gives you a more robust basis for advising pregnant patients with twins on exercise.
items.limitation: 这是一项对急性运动反应的评估，未涉及长期运动干预的效果和安全性。
items.limitationEn: This study assessed acute exercise responses and did not evaluate the long-term effects or safety of exercise interventions.

items.title: Return to sport after primary anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction in athletes with a preinjury Tegner Activity Scale >=7: a longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study
items.summary: A longitudinal, nationwide, registry-based cohort study of 511 female and male athletes with a pre-injury Tegner Activity Scale ≥7 found that 62% achieved return to sport (Tegner Activity Scale ≥7) within 24 months after primary ACL reconstruction, with an average duration of 12.3 months. However, only 51% returned to their pre-injury level.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对高水平运动员的全国性研究提供了ACL重建术后重返运动（RTS）的详细随访数据。尽管大多数运动员能在24个月内重返原高水平运动，但仍有近半数未能完全恢复到受伤前状态。这提示你管理患者期望并进行更精细的RTS评估至关重要。
items.titleZh: Tegner活动量表评分≥7的运动员初次前交叉韧带重建术后重返运动：一项基于全国注册的纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对511名术前Tegner活动量表评分≥7的男性和女性运动员进行的全国性、基于注册的纵向队列研究发现，62%的运动员在初次ACL重建术后24个月内重返运动（Tegner活动量表≥7），平均持续时间为12.3个月。然而，只有51%的参与者完全恢复到受伤前水平。
items.curatedReasonEn: This nationwide study on high-level athletes provides detailed follow-up data on return to sport (RTS) after ACL reconstruction. While most athletes returned to their pre-injury level within 24 months, nearly half did not fully recover. This underscores the importance of managing patient expectations and conducting more refined RTS assessments.
items.limitation: 研究依赖于患者自报的Tegner活动量表评分，可能存在回忆偏差和主观性。
items.limitationEn: The study relied on patient-reported Tegner Activity Scale scores, which may introduce recall bias and subjectivity.

items.title: Examining the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of Para athletes in elite sport: a qualitative description study
items.summary: A qualitative descriptive study explored the pregnancy and postpartum experiences of elite Para athletes, revealing pervasive disability-specific knowledge gaps among coaches, healthcare providers, and sport organizations. Para athletes navigated equipment adaptations, health monitoring, and training modifications with insufficient support due to a lack of disability-informed expertise.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了残疾运动员在妊娠和产后阶段面临的独特挑战，包括教练和医疗服务提供者的知识空白以及政策支持的不足。这提示你，为残疾运动员提供支持需要更专业、更个体化的指导和资源。
items.titleZh: 精英运动中残疾运动员的妊娠和产后经历：一项定性描述研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性描述研究探讨了精英残疾运动员的妊娠和产后经历，揭示了教练、医疗服务提供者和体育组织中普遍存在的残疾特异性知识空白。残疾运动员在缺乏残疾知情专业知识的情况下，在器械调整、健康监测和训练修改方面获得了不足的支持。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study highlights the unique challenges faced by Para athletes during pregnancy and postpartum, including knowledge gaps among coaches and healthcare providers, and inadequate policy support. This suggests that supporting Para athletes requires more specialized and individualized guidance and resources.
items.limitation: 定性研究结果的普遍性可能受限，且样本量较小。
items.limitationEn: The generalizability of qualitative study findings may be limited, and the sample size was small.

items.title: Pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation: reporting quality, progression to trials, and barriers: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 28 pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation found that reporting quality averaged 6.1 out of 11 points, and only 12% (3 out of 26) progressed to a definitive randomized controlled trial. Lack of funding was the primary barrier for not proceeding to an RCT.
items.curatedReason: 卒中康复领域先导性和可行性研究的报告质量普遍不足，且仅有少数研究能最终进展为随机对照试验。这提示你在评估新干预措施时，对早期研究的结论应保持高度审慎。
items.titleZh: 卒中康复领域的先导性和可行性研究：报告质量、进展到试验情况及障碍：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项对28项卒中康复先导性和可行性研究的范围综述发现，这些研究的报告质量平均为11分中的6.1分，且仅有12%（26项中的3项）最终进展为随机对照试验。缺乏资金是未能进一步开展RCT的主要原因。
items.curatedReasonEn: Reporting quality of pilot and feasibility studies in stroke rehabilitation is generally suboptimal, with only a small fraction progressing to definitive RCTs. This indicates you should maintain high caution when evaluating conclusions from early-stage studies on new interventions.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，评估的是研究报告质量而非干预效果。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, evaluating reporting quality rather than intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Georges Gymnastics Program: scaling an inclusive, school-based gymnastics service for children with intellectual disability through an Olympic training centre partnership
items.summary: In Australia, approximately 1 in 20 children under 15 live with intellectual disability, facing higher risks of lifestyle-related health problems and barriers to sport participation.
items.curatedReason: Georges体操项目与奥运训练中心的合作，为智力障碍儿童提供了包容性的学校体操服务，展示了将专业运动资源应用于特殊儿童康复的有效模式。这提示你可以探索类似的跨界合作，以扩大康复服务的可及性和质量。
items.titleZh: Georges体操项目：通过与奥运训练中心合作，扩大为智力障碍儿童提供的包容性校本体操服务
items.summaryZh: Georges体操项目通过与奥运训练中心合作，成功地为智力障碍儿童提供了包容性的校本体操服务，旨在改善其身体活动和独立性。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Georges Gymnastics Program's partnership with an Olympic training center offers inclusive school-based gymnastics for children with intellectual disabilities, showcasing an effective model for applying elite sports resources to special needs rehabilitation. This suggests you could explore similar cross-sector collaborations to expand the accessibility and quality of rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 这是一项描述项目开展的文章，而非对项目效果进行严格评估的研究。
items.limitationEn: This article describes a program implementation, not a rigorous evaluation of its effects.

items.title: Endometriosis and elite sports: a blind spot in research
items.summary: This commentary highlights that endometriosis, a chronic inflammatory disease affecting over 10% of women of reproductive age, remains a significant blind spot in sports research. Its symptoms, including severe dysmenorrhea, chronic pelvic pain, and fatigue, can profoundly impact elite female athletes' daily functioning, training capacity, recovery, and performance.
items.curatedReason: 子宫内膜异位症在运动研究中仍是一个“盲点”，其症状可能严重影响女性运动员的训练能力、恢复和表现。这提示你在评估和治疗女性运动员时，需警惕并关注此类慢性疾病的影响，并倡导更多相关研究。
items.titleZh: 子宫内膜异位症与精英运动：研究中的一个盲点
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评指出，子宫内膜异位症作为一种影响全球超过10%育龄女性的慢性炎症性疾病，在运动研究中仍是一个显著的盲点。其症状（包括严重痛经、慢性盆腔疼痛和疲劳）可能对精英女性运动员的日常功能、训练能力、恢复和表现产生深远影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Endometriosis remains a "blind spot" in sports research, yet its symptoms can severely impact female athletes' training capacity, recovery, and performance. This suggests you should be vigilant and attentive to the effects of such chronic conditions when evaluating and treating female athletes, and advocate for more related research.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评，旨在强调研究空白，未提供具体的研究数据。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary highlighting a research gap, not providing specific research data.

items.title: Effectiveness of conservative interventions on pain and disability in degenerative cervical spine disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of 18 RCTs (2,378 participants) found conservative interventions were associated with significant reductions in pain (SMD = -0.67; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.37; I² = 87.20%) and disability (SMD = -0.60; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.24; I² = 91.56%) in degenerative cervical spine disease, with acupuncture and exercise-based interventions showing benefit, but manual therapy showing no significant pooled benefit. The certainty of evidence was low.
items.curatedReason: 保守治疗对退行性颈椎病有帮助，可以缓解疼痛和改善功能，尤其是针灸和运动。但请注意，手法治疗没有显著的汇总效益，而且总体证据确定性很低。向患者解释时，要如实说明证据的局限性，别夸大疗效。
items.titleZh: 保守干预对退行性颈椎病疼痛和功能障碍的有效性：一项随机对照试验的系统综述和Meta分析
items.summaryZh: 一项纳入18项随机对照试验（2378名参与者）的系统综述和Meta分析发现，保守干预与退行性颈椎病患者的疼痛（SMD = -0.67; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.37; I² = 87.20%）和功能障碍（SMD = -0.60; 95% CI, -0.97 to -0.24; I² = 91.56%）显著减轻相关。其中针灸和运动干预显示益处，但手法治疗的 pooled 益处不显著。证据确定性较低。
items.curatedReasonEn: Conservative interventions help with degenerative cervical spine disease, alleviating pain and improving function, especially acupuncture and exercise. However, note that manual therapy showed no significant pooled benefit, and overall evidence certainty is low. When explaining to patients, be truthful about the evidence limitations and don't overstate efficacy.
items.limitation: 研究纳入的RCT数量有限，保守治疗干预措施异质性高，且证据确定性低（low certainty of evidence），限制了结论的强度和特异性。
items.limitationEn: The limited number of included RCTs, high heterogeneity of conservative interventions, and low certainty of evidence limit the strength and specificity of the conclusions.

items.title:
Rhythm-centred music interventions for motor coordination and rehabilitation: a scoping review of mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A scoping review of 63 studies identified rhythm-centered music interventions for motor coordination and rehabilitation, summarizing their mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment approaches (e.g., sensors, motion capture). Coordination-related tasks were common targets, with rhythm being the most frequently used musical element.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围审查总结了以节奏为中心的音乐干预在运动协调和康复中的机制、设计原则和技术辅助评估方法。这提示您在设计和实施音乐疗法时，应关注节奏元素，并可结合传感器等技术辅助评估，以提升干预的精准性和有效性。
items.titleZh: 以节奏为中心的音乐干预在运动协调和康复中的应用：机制、设计原则和技术辅助评估的范围审查
items.summaryZh: 一项对63项研究的范围审查发现，以节奏为中心的音乐干预可用于运动协调和康复，并总结了其机制、设计原则和技术辅助评估方法（例如传感器、动作捕捉）。协调相关任务是常见目标，节奏是最常用的音乐元素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review summarizes mechanisms, design principles, and technology-assisted assessment approaches for rhythm-centered music interventions in motor coordination and rehabilitation. This suggests that when designing and implementing music therapy, you should focus on rhythmic elements and consider incorporating technology-assisted assessments, such as sensors, to enhance the precision and effectiveness of interventions.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围审查，仅提供描述性证据模式，而非治疗效果的明确估计，且研究异质性高，限制了具体临床建议的得出。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review, providing only descriptive evidence patterns rather than definitive estimates of therapeutic efficacy, and high study heterogeneity limits the derivation of specific clinical recommendations.

items.title: Clarifying 'youth: why conceptual and ethical clarity matters in sport
items.summary: This editorial discusses conceptual and ethical issues arising from the variable operational labels used to define 'youth' athletes across research, policy, and practice domains in sport.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论文章指出，体育运动中“青年”的定义不明确，这会带来概念和伦理问题。这提醒您在解读针对青少年运动员的研究和指南时，需注意术语的一致性，以确保临床实践的准确性。
items.titleZh: 澄清“青年”：为什么概念和伦理清晰度在体育运动中至关重要
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论讨论了在体育运动中，研究、政策和实践领域对“青年”运动员的定义术语不一致所产生的概念和伦理问题。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary highlights the conceptual and ethical issues arising from the inconsistent definition of 'youth' in sport. This reminds you to pay attention to terminology consistency when interpreting research and guidelines on youth athletes to ensure accuracy in clinical practice.

items.title: Championing choice: the Womens Tennis Association Fertility Protection Programme for professional women tennis players
items.summary: This commentary highlights the distinct barriers women face in high-performance sport regarding fertility, emphasizing the Women's Tennis Association Fertility Protection Programme as a crucial consideration for professional female tennis players.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论文章强调了职业女网球运动员在生育后面临的独特障碍，以及WTA生育保护计划的重要性。这提示您在服务女性运动员时，应更全面地考虑其生育健康和职业发展之间的平衡，并熟悉相关支持政策。
items.titleZh: 倡导选择：女子网球协会职业女网球运动员生育保护计划
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论强调了女性在竞技体育中面临的独特生育障碍，并强调了女子网球协会生育保护计划对于职业女网球运动员的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary emphasizes the unique barriers professional female tennis players face regarding fertility and the importance of the WTA Fertility Protection Programme. This suggests that when treating female athletes, you should comprehensively consider the balance between their reproductive health and career development, and be familiar with relevant support policies.

items.title: Time to act: why menopause should be a priority in sports and exercise medicine
items.summary: This commentary advocates for prioritizing menopause in sports and exercise medicine, highlighting its definition, symptoms, and potential impact on physical performance and health in women.
items.curatedReason: 如果你还在用“大妈”或“更年期综合征”来笼统概括中年女性的运动表现下降，那就太落伍了。这篇评论文章强调，是时候把更年期对女性运动和健康的具体影响提上运动医学的议事日程，我们需要更精细地调整干预策略。
items.titleZh: 是时候行动了：为什么更年期应成为运动医学界的优先事项
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章呼吁运动医学界优先关注更年期，强调其定义、症状以及对女性身体表现和健康的潜在影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: If you're still broadly attributing decreased athletic performance in middle-aged women to 'aging' or 'menopause syndrome,' you're behind the times. This commentary emphasizes that it's time to prioritize the specific impact of menopause on women's athletic performance and health in sports medicine. We need to refine our intervention strategies accordingly.

items.title: 'Written in English: has English as the lingua franca of mental health research in sport and parasport become a barrier to creating culturally and contextually situated mental health care?
items.summary: This commentary argues that English as the lingua franca of mental health research in sport and parasport may act as a barrier to culturally and contextually situated mental healthcare, advocating for greater linguistic inclusivity.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论文章指出，英语作为运动与残疾人运动心理健康研究的通用语言，可能阻碍了文化和情境化护理的发展。这提示您在获取和应用研究证据时，要警惕语言霸权可能造成的文化偏见和信息不平衡，探索多元语言资源，以更好地服务不同文化背景的患者。
items.titleZh: “用英文写就”：英文作为运动与残疾人运动心理健康研究的通用语言是否已成为创建文化和情境化心理健康护理的障碍？
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论文章认为，英语作为运动和残疾人运动心理健康研究的通用语言，可能阻碍了文化和情境化心理健康护理的发展，并呼吁提高语言包容性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary suggests that English as the lingua franca in sport and parasport mental health research may hinder the development of culturally and contextually situated care. This reminds you to be aware of potential cultural biases and information imbalances caused by linguistic dominance when accessing and applying research evidence, and to explore multilingual resources to better serve patients from diverse cultural backgrounds.

items.title: Implementation gap: a 3-year reality check in body composition monitoring in sport
items.summary: This editorial addresses the "implementation gap" in body composition monitoring in sport, urging for greater commitment to translate existing evidence-informed recommendations on athlete body composition assessment into everyday practice to safeguard athlete health.
items.curatedReason: 这篇评论文章审视了国际奥委会关于运动员身体成分监测建议的实施情况，发现仍存在“实施差距”。这提示您在实际工作中，应持续关注并将基于证据的身体成分评估和管理建议转化为日常实践，以更好地保护运动员健康。
items.titleZh: 实施差距：运动中身体成分监测的3年现实检验
items.summaryZh: 这篇社论讨论了运动中身体成分监测的“实施差距”，呼吁将现有的循证建议转化为日常实践，以更好地保障运动员的健康。
items.curatedReasonEn: This commentary reviews the implementation of IOC recommendations for athlete body composition monitoring, noting an "implementation gap." This suggests that in your practice, you should continuously focus on translating evidence-based body composition assessment and management recommendations into daily practice to better protect athlete health.

items.title: 'Avoid vigorous exercise until further notice: recovery after cholesteatoma surgery
items.summary: This commentary shares a personal experience of recovering from cholesteatoma surgery, highlighting the uncertainty and challenges of returning to vigorous exercise and managing stress during a prolonged recovery period.
items.curatedReason: 这篇作者自述的评论文章，以个体经历探讨了胆脂瘤手术后重返运动的挑战和不确定性。这提示您在术后康复指导中，需要更清晰、更个性化地解释运动限制，并充分考虑患者的心理和生活方式需求。
items.titleZh: “在进一步通知前避免剧烈运动”：胆脂瘤手术后的恢复
items.summaryZh: 这篇评论分享了作者胆脂瘤手术后的个人康复经历，强调了在漫长恢复期内，重返剧烈运动和管理压力的不确定性和挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: This autobiographical commentary explores the challenges and uncertainties of returning to sport after cholesteatoma surgery through an individual's experience. This suggests that in postoperative rehabilitation guidance, you need to explain exercise restrictions more clearly and individually, and fully consider the patient's psychological and lifestyle needs.

items.title: Influence of shoulder strength on throwing velocity in handball (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD abstract outlines research on how comprehensive shoulder strength profiles influence handball throwing velocity, including the development and validation of a functional shoulder dynamogram to quantify dynamic strength across multiple planes of movement.
items.curatedReason: 这篇博士论文摘要探讨了肩部力量对手球投掷速度的影响，开发并验证了功能性肩部测力图。这提示您在评估和训练手球运动员时，需更全面地评估肩部多平面动态力量，这可能对手球运动表现至关重要。
items.titleZh: 肩部力量对手球投掷速度的影响（博士学术奖）
items.summaryZh: 这篇博士论文摘要概述了关于肩部力量如何影响手球投掷速度的研究，包括开发和验证一种功能性肩部测力图，以量化多平面动态力量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD abstract explores the influence of shoulder strength on handball throwing velocity and describes the development and validation of a functional shoulder dynamogram. This suggests that when evaluating and training handball players, you need to comprehensively assess multi-planar dynamic shoulder strength, which may be crucial for handball performance.

items.title: Sex differences in performance fatigability: evidence from a maximal intermittent protocol using a flywheel device (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD abstract investigates sex differences in the mechanisms underlying performance fatigability following a maximal intermittent fatiguing protocol using a flywheel device, focusing on performance decline, voluntary muscle activity, and electrically-evoked mechanical/electromyographical variables.
items.curatedReason: 这篇博士论文摘要探究了最大间歇性协议下，男女在运动疲劳表现上的性别差异。这提示您在制定训练和康复方案时，应考虑生理性别对疲劳机制的影响，以优化个性化干预策略。
items.titleZh: 表现疲劳的性别差异：来自使用飞轮设备的最大间歇协议的证据（博士学术奖）
items.summaryZh: 这篇博士论文摘要研究了使用飞轮设备进行最大间歇性疲劳协议后，表现疲劳机制的性别差异，重点关注表现下降、自主肌肉活动以及电诱发机械/肌电变量。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD abstract investigates sex differences in performance fatigability during maximal intermittent protocols. This suggests that when designing training and rehabilitation programs, you should consider the influence of biological sex on fatigue mechanisms to optimize individualized intervention strategies.

items.title: Development of an upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework (PhD Academy Award)
items.summary: This PhD abstract outlines the development of a stakeholder-informed upper and lower limb athlete pain assessment framework to enhance clinician/researcher and athlete interaction by comprehensively assessing pain through a multidimensional, biopsychosocial lens.
items.curatedReason: 这篇博士论文摘要旨在提出一个利益相关者知情的上下肢运动员疼痛评估框架。这提示您在临床实践中，应更全面地评估运动员的疼痛，整合生物、心理、认知和社会环境等多维度因素，以提升疼痛管理的有效性。
items.titleZh: 上下肢运动员疼痛评估框架的开发（博士学术奖）
items.summaryZh: 这篇博士论文摘要概述了开发一个利益相关者知情的上下肢运动员疼痛评估框架，旨在通过多维度生物心理社会视角全面评估疼痛，以增强临床医生/研究人员与运动员的互动。
items.curatedReasonEn: This PhD abstract aims to propose a stakeholder-informed framework for assessing upper and lower limb pain in athletes. This suggests that in clinical practice, you should comprehensively assess athlete pain, integrating biological, psychological, cognitive, and socio-environmental factors to enhance the effectiveness of pain management.

items.title: Photobiomodulation therapy has a negligible effect as an adjunct to motor control exercise in people with chronic non-specific low back pain: a randomised trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (n=148) found that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise provided negligible additional improvements in pain intensity (MD -0.4 points, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4) or disability (MD -0.7 points, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9) compared with sham PBMT in adults with chronic non-specific low back pain over 12 months.
items.curatedReason: 这项大型 RCT 明确表明，对于慢性非特异性腰痛，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）并无额外临床益处。下次评估腰痛方案时，请将 PBMT 从常规选项中排除。
items.titleZh: 光生物调节疗法作为运动控制训练的辅助手段，对慢性非特异性腰痛患者的疗效微乎其微：一项随机试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（n=148）发现，对于慢性非特异性腰痛成人，在运动控制训练中加入光生物调节疗法（PBMT）与假 PBMT 相比，在 12 个月内对疼痛强度（MD -0.4 分, 95% CI -1.2 to 0.4）或残疾（MD -0.7 分, 95% CI -2.4 to 0.9）没有临床上重要的额外改善。
items.curatedReasonEn: This large RCT clearly shows that adding photobiomodulation therapy (PBMT) to motor control exercise offers no additional clinical benefit for chronic non-specific low back pain. Exclude PBMT from routine options when evaluating back pain protocols.
items.limitation: 研究排除了有特定病理或脊柱手术史的患者，结果主要适用于慢性非特异性腰痛人群。
items.limitationEn: The study excluded patients with specific pathologies or previous spinal surgery, so results primarily apply to individuals with chronic non-specific low back pain.

items.title: Efficacy of physiotherapy in reducing pain in subjects with temporomandibular disorders: a systematic review with network meta-analysis
items.summary: A network meta-analysis of 25 RCTs (n=1,540) found that manual therapy and therapeutic exercise were effective for reducing pain in temporomandibular disorders, with multimodal treatments being most effective. The combination of dry needling and manual therapy appeared to be the most effective approach.
items.curatedReason: 这项网络荟萃分析支持手法治疗和治疗性运动是颞下颌关节紊乱（TMDs）止痛的有效一线干预。当患者出现 TMDs 相关疼痛时，你应优先考虑这些非侵入性治疗手段，且干针联合手法治疗似乎是最有效的组合。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱患者疼痛方面的疗效：一项网络荟萃分析的系统综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项包含 25 项随机对照试验（n=1,540）的网络荟萃分析发现，手法治疗和治疗性运动在减轻颞下颌关节紊乱疼痛方面有效，其中多模式治疗最为有效。干针结合手法治疗似乎是最有效的方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network meta-analysis supports manual therapy and therapeutic exercise as effective first-line interventions for pain reduction in temporomandibular disorders (TMDs). When patients present with TMDs-related pain, you should prioritize these non-invasive treatments, and dry needling combined with manual therapy appears to be the most effective combination.
items.limitation: 纳入研究的方法学质量存在异质性（PEDro 评分 3-9 分），可能影响荟萃分析的整体证据强度。
items.limitationEn: The methodological quality of the included studies was heterogeneous (PEDro scores ranging from 3 to 9), which may affect the overall strength of evidence in the meta-analysis.

items.title: Continuity of care interventions for people with stroke and their caregivers: a scoping review of randomized controlled trials.
items.summary: This scoping review of 80 RCTs found that continuity of care interventions for stroke most often included only stroke survivors and focused on the transition from acute to home care, often neglecting family-centered approaches and other critical transitions in the care continuum.
items.curatedReason: 这项范围综述指出，中风患者及其照护者的连续性照护干预研究，常未能同时纳入两者，且未充分涵盖所有照护过渡阶段。你设计康复方案时，要确保覆盖急性期到居家照护之外的更多过渡，并始终以家庭为中心。
items.titleZh: 针对中风患者及其照护者的连续性照护干预：一项随机对照试验的范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 这项对 80 项随机对照试验的范围综述发现，中风连续性照护干预最常只包括中风幸存者，并侧重于从急性期到居家照护的过渡，常忽略以家庭为中心的方法和照护连续体中其他关键过渡。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates that continuity of care interventions for stroke patients and caregivers often don't include both, and don't adequately cover all care transitions. When designing rehabilitation plans, ensure broader coverage beyond acute to home care transitions, and always adopt a family-centered approach.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，此研究综合了 RCT 的存在和类型，但未评估干预的具体疗效，也未纳入非随机研究。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, this study synthesized the existence and types of RCTs but did not evaluate the specific efficacy of interventions and did not include non-randomized studies.

items.title: Technical and clinical feasibility of a pulmonary telerehabilitation model for people with COPD.
items.summary: A two-phase feasibility study found that a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation (HBPR) model for COPD patients was technically feasible (device data transmission agreement >99%) and clinically feasible, with high patient retention (95%), satisfaction (median 30), and usability (median 80.0), alongside increased endurance time (median difference 171.00 seconds).
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，COPD 患者居家肺康复（HBPR）模型在技术和临床上均可行，设备数据传输准确，患者满意度高，并有初步的耐力改善。这支持了远程 HBPR 作为一种可行的康复模式，你可以考虑将其整合到慢性病管理中，但仍需等待更大规模的 RCT 验证疗效。
items.titleZh: COPD 患者肺远程康复模型的技术和临床可行性。
items.summaryZh: 一项两阶段可行性研究发现，COPD 患者的居家肺远程康复（HBPR）模型在技术上（设备数据传输一致性 >99%）和临床上均可行，具有高患者依从性（95%）、满意度（中位数 30）和可用性（中位数 80.0），同时耐力时间增加（中位数差异 171.00 秒）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study demonstrates the technical and clinical feasibility of a home-based pulmonary telerehabilitation (HBPR) model for COPD patients, showing accurate device data transmission, high patient satisfaction, and preliminary endurance improvements. This supports tele-HBPR as a viable rehabilitation mode you can integrate into chronic disease management, but awaits larger RCTs for efficacy validation.
items.limitation: 本研究为可行性研究，样本量小（n=20），且未设置对照组，无法评估临床疗效的确定性。
items.limitationEn: This study is a feasibility study with a small sample size (n=20) and no control group, so it cannot definitively assess clinical efficacy.

items.title: Physiotherapy management of persistent pelvic pain.
items.summary: This narrative review synthesizes current evidence on physiotherapy for persistent pelvic pain, outlining key principles and diverse interventions tailored to individual patient needs and pain mechanisms.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述为持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理提供了最新概览，强调了多模式、个体化治疗在不同表型患者中的应用前景。
items.titleZh: 持续性盆腔疼痛的物理治疗管理。
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述综合了当前关于持续性盆腔疼痛物理治疗的证据，概述了根据患者个体需求和疼痛机制量身定制的关键原则和多样化干预措施。
items.curatedReasonEn: This review offers an updated overview of physiotherapy management for persistent pelvic pain, highlighting the potential of multimodal, individualized treatment across different patient phenotypes.

items.title: Financial burden, non-medical drivers of health, and early caregiving role formation after stroke: a scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review of 16 studies found that caregiver assessments inconsistently capture financial toxicity and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH) after stroke. Most studies only assessed subjective financial strain or a single objective indicator, highlighting a need for multidimensional integration in future instruments.
items.curatedReason: 此范围综述揭示，现有中风照护者评估工具未能充分捕捉财务负担和非医疗健康决定因素。你的评估应整合多维度的财务毒性和 NMDOH 指标，以更全面识别脆弱性，并支持更公平、可持续的康复。
items.titleZh: 中风后财务负担、非医疗健康决定因素与早期照护角色形成：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项对 16 项研究的范围综述发现，中风后照护者评估未能一致地捕捉财务毒性和非医疗健康决定因素（NMDOH）。大多数研究仅评估了主观财务压力或单一客观指标，凸显了未来工具中多维度整合的需求。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review reveals that current stroke caregiver assessments inadequately capture financial burden and non-medical drivers of health (NMDOH). Your evaluations should integrate multidimensional financial toxicity and NMDOH measures to better identify vulnerabilities and support equitable, sustainable recovery.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，未对纳入研究的证据质量进行严格评估，且仅限于过去十年的出版物。
items.limitationEn: This study is a scoping review, which did not rigorously assess the quality of evidence of included studies and was limited to publications from the last ten years.

items.title: Early Changes in Post-Stroke Quality of Life and Associated Factors: A Prospective Study.
items.summary: A prospective study of 111 first-ever stroke patients found that physical and psychosocial HRQoL showed divergent recovery trajectories over 3 months. Functional ambulation (β = 0.483, p < 0.001) was associated with physical HRQoL, while depressive symptom severity (β = -0.692, p < 0.001) was associated with mental HRQoL.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后早期康复中，身体功能（如步态）和抑郁症状对患者生活质量的改善轨迹有不同影响。制定康复计划时，除了关注身体机能，也务必及早识别并干预抑郁情绪，因为它显著影响患者心理层面的生活质量。
items.titleZh: 卒中后生活质量的早期变化及相关因素：一项前瞻性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项针对111名首次卒中患者的前瞻性研究发现，卒中后3个月内身体和心理社会层面的生活质量恢复轨迹存在差异。功能性步态（β = 0.483, p < 0.001）与身体生活质量改善相关，而抑郁症状严重程度（β = -0.692, p < 0.001）与心理生活质量改善相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: In early post-stroke rehabilitation, physical function (e.g., ambulation) and depressive symptoms impact quality of life (HRQoL) improvement differently. When planning rehabilitation, prioritize early identification and intervention for depression, as it significantly affects mental HRQoL, in addition to physical function.
items.limitation: 本研究随访期仅为3个月，可能无法捕捉长期HRQoL的变化，且样本量较小（n=111）。
items.limitationEn: The study's follow-up period was only 3 months, which may not capture long-term HRQoL changes, and the sample size was relatively small (n=111).

items.title: Efficacy of Sensory Electrical Stimulation Versus Alternating Electromyography-Guided Electrical Stimulation on Functional Recovery of the Hand in Chronic Stroke: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial (n=60) found that both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) combined with conventional physical therapy led to significantly greater improvements in upper-limb motor function (ARAT scores increased by 12.05 and 12.44 points respectively, P < .001) compared to conventional physical therapy alone in chronic stroke patients, with no significant difference between SES and Alt-EMG.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性卒中患者的手功能恢复，感觉电刺激 (SES) 和交替肌电图引导电刺激 (Alt-EMG) 都比单纯常规物理治疗效果更好，但两者之间没有显著差异。在设计手功能康复方案时，不必纠结于这两种电刺激技术的选择，可优先考虑患者依从性和设备可及性。
items.titleZh: 感觉电刺激与交替肌电图引导电刺激对慢性卒中手功能恢复疗效的随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机对照试验（n=60）发现，在慢性卒中患者中，结合常规物理治疗的感觉电刺激（SES）和交替肌电图引导电刺激（Alt-EMG）均能显著改善上肢运动功能（ARAT 评分分别增加 12.05 和 12.44 分，P < .001），效果优于单独的常规物理治疗，但 SES 与 Alt-EMG 之间没有显著差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: For hand function recovery in chronic stroke patients, both sensory electrical stimulation (SES) and alternating electromyography-guided electrical stimulation (Alt-EMG) are superior to conventional physical therapy alone, but there is no significant difference between the two. When designing hand rehabilitation programs, focus on patient adherence and equipment availability rather than overthinking the choice between these two electrical stimulation techniques.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 60 人，随访期为 12 周，可能限制了长期效应和在不同卒中阶段的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: The study included 60 participants with a 12-week follow-up, which may limit the generalizability of long-term effects and applicability across different stroke stages.

items.title: Effects of Exercise Training on the Metabolic Cost of Walking in Health and Disease: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis (27 studies, 1177 participants) found that chronic physical exercise training improved the metabolic cost of walking (g = 0.40, p = 0.001) in healthy adults (g = 0.49, p = 0.001), but had smaller, non-significant effects in stroke patients (g = 0.24, p = 0.065), with higher BMI associated with smaller intervention effects.
items.curatedReason: 这项荟萃分析明确指出，慢性运动训练能改善健康成年人的步行代谢成本，但在卒中患者中效果较小，且肥胖可能削弱这种益处。在为患者制定运动方案时，应考虑这些群体特异性，对卒中患者设置更实际的步行经济性改善预期，并同时关注体重管理。
items.titleZh: 运动训练对健康和疾病状态下步行代谢成本影响的系统综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析（27 项研究，1177 名参与者）发现，慢性身体运动训练改善了健康成年人的步行代谢成本（g = 0.40，p = 0.001），其中健康个体效果显著（g = 0.49，p = 0.001），但在卒中患者中效果较小且不显著（g = 0.24，p = 0.065），较高的 BMI 与较小的干预效果相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This meta-analysis clearly indicates that chronic exercise training improves the metabolic cost of walking in healthy adults, with smaller effects in stroke patients, and obesity may diminish this benefit. When designing exercise programs, consider these population-specific factors, set more realistic expectations for improved walking economy in stroke patients, and simultaneously focus on weight management.
items.limitation: 尽管包含了 27 项研究，但神经系统疾病患者的样本量相对较小，尤其是多发性硬化和帕金森病患者仅各一项研究，限制了对这些群体结果的确定性。
items.limitationEn: Despite including 27 studies, the sample size for neurological conditions was relatively small, with only one study each for multiple sclerosis and Parkinson's disease, limiting the certainty of results for these groups.

items.title: Development of Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH): A complex Intervention to Monitor and Support Self-Management of Post-Stroke Psychological Changes Within a Matched Care Model.
items.summary: The Enhanced Reviews of Psychological Changes After Stroke (ENRICH) program is a brief intervention designed to monitor and support self-management of post-stroke psychological changes (cognition, mood, anxiety, fatigue) through three reviews at 1, 3, and 6 months, showing potential to address gaps in UK post-stroke care.
items.curatedReason: ENRICH 项目为卒中后轻中度认知、情绪、焦虑和疲劳改变的患者提供了监测和自我管理支持，可作为英国卒中社区护理的补充。这提示我们可以关注此类患者的心理变化，并考虑将类似简短干预整合到常规康复路径中，尤其在资源有限的社区环境中。
items.titleZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目的开发：一项复杂干预，旨在匹配护理模型中监测和支持卒中后心理变化的自我管理
items.summaryZh: 卒中后心理变化强化评估 (ENRICH) 项目是一项旨在通过在 1、3 和 6 个月进行三次评估，监测和支持卒中后心理变化（认知、情绪、焦虑、疲劳）自我管理的简短干预措施，有望弥补英国卒中后护理的空白。
items.curatedReasonEn: The ENRICH program offers monitoring and self-management support for post-stroke patients with mild-to-moderate cognitive, mood, anxiety, and fatigue changes, complementing UK stroke community care. This suggests focusing on such psychological changes in patients and integrating similar brief interventions into standard rehabilitation pathways, especially in resource-limited community settings.
items.limitation: 这是一项复杂干预措施的设计和开发报告，尚未进行临床有效性测试，其效果尚不明确。
items.limitationEn: This is a report on the design and development of a complex intervention, with clinical effectiveness testing still planned, so its impact is not yet clear.

items.title: The Current State of Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: Graft Selection, Lateral Augmentation, Rehabilitation, and Return-to-Play.
items.summary: This review highlights shifts in ACL reconstruction toward quadriceps tendon autografts and lateral augmentation for high-risk knees. It emphasizes that return-to-play decisions should be criteria-based, combining time from surgery, functional criteria, and psychological readiness, given that limb symmetry index may overestimate recovery and psychological readiness independently impacts re-injury risk.
items.curatedReason: ACL 重建术后的康复和重返运动评估，已从固定时间转向基于标准的评估。未来 ACLR 患者的重返运动方案，应结合手术时间、功能标准和心理准备度进行综合判断。特别注意患者心理准备度对重返运动和二次损伤风险的独立影响。
items.titleZh: 前交叉韧带重建的现状：移植物选择、外侧增强、康复和重返运动
items.summaryZh: 本综述重点介绍了前交叉韧带重建术向股四头肌腱自体移植和高危膝关节外侧增强的转变。它强调重返运动的决定应基于标准，结合术后时间、功能标准和心理准备，因为肢体对称指数可能高估恢复程度，且心理准备独立影响再次受伤风险。
items.curatedReasonEn: Post-ACLR rehabilitation and return-to-play assessment have shifted from fixed timelines to criteria-based evaluation. Future return-to-play protocols for ACLR patients should integrate surgical time, functional criteria, and psychological readiness. Pay particular attention to the independent impact of psychological readiness on return-to-sport and second injury risk.
items.limitation: 这是一篇叙述性综述，信息整合可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏系统的证据评估方法。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review, and information synthesis may be subject to selection bias, lacking systematic evidence evaluation methods.

items.title:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summary: A 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates-based exercise and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and depressive symptoms compared to usual care in this RCT.
items.curatedReason: 6个月的线上康复训练（Pilates+筋膜放松）显著改善了纤维肌痛患者的症状和睡眠，别再依赖线下常规治疗了。
items.titleZh: 结合普拉提治疗性锻炼和自我筋膜松解术的六个月监督远程康复治疗对纤维肌痛症患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.titleEn:
Six-month supervised telerehabilitation combining pilates-based therapeutic exercise and self-myofascial release in adults with fibromyalgia: a randomized controlled trial
							| Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验发现，为期六个月的监督性远程康复项目，结合了普拉提为基础的锻炼和自我筋膜松解术，与常规护理相比，显著改善了纤维肌痛症患者的影响、睡眠质量和心理结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT found that a 6-month supervised telerehabilitation program combining Pilates and self-myofascial release significantly improved fibromyalgia impact, sleep quality, and psychological outcomes compared to usual care.
items.limitation: 未评估 6 个月以上远期疗效，焦虑结果未显示显著改善。
items.limitationEn: Long-term effects beyond 6 months were not assessed, and anxiety outcomes did not show significant improvement.

items.title: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults
items.summary: This study found dysphagia in frail older adults is linked to decreased physical performance (SPPB) and increased fall risk, highlighting the need for routine swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究发现，虚弱老年人的吞咽困难与身体机能下降（SPPB 评分较低）和跌倒风险增加显著相关。这意味着在老年病护理中，常规进行吞咽评估至关重要，不应忽视吞咽功能对整体健康和安全的影响。
items.titleZh: 吞咽困难与衰弱老年人身体机能及跌倒风险的关联
items.titleEn: Association of dysphagia with physical performance and fall risk in frail older adults | BMC Geriatrics | Springer Nature Link
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，衰弱老年人的吞咽困难与其较差的身体机能（SPPB 评分降低）和较高的跌倒风险显著相关，强调了在老年护理中进行吞咽评估的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study found that dysphagia in frail older adults is significantly associated with poorer physical performance (lower SPPB scores) and increased fall risk, underscoring the importance of swallowing assessments in geriatric care.
items.limitation: 这是一项回顾性观察性研究，样本量相对较小（109 例）。
items.limitationEn: This was a retrospective observational study with a relatively small sample size (109 patients).

items.title: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review
items.summary: This narrative review debunks the heel-strike fallacy and the universal 180 steps/min cadence belief in running, emphasizing individualized adjustments based on specific goals.
items.curatedReason: 这篇综述批驳了跑步中“脚跟着地有害”的误解和“每分钟 180 步是普适步频”的信条，强调跑步姿势和步频应根据个体目标进行调整。这意味着我们不应盲目遵循普遍建议，而应根据患者具体情况和目标来指导跑步训练。
items.titleZh: 后足触地谬误与跑者步频信念：一项叙述性综述
items.titleEn: The Heel-Strike Fallacy and Cadence Beliefs in Distance Running: A Narrative Review | Sports Medicine - Open | Springer Nature Link
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述挑战了长跑中常见的信念，指出后足触地并非固有危害，180步/分钟并非普遍最优步频，且改变应基于个体目标而非普遍性标准。
items.curatedReasonEn: This narrative review challenges common beliefs in distance running, stating that rearfoot striking is not inherently harmful, 180 steps/min is not universally optimal cadence, and that changes should be based on individual goals rather than generalized targets.
items.limitation: 本文为叙述性综述，不呈现新的实证数据；建议基于现有文献综合。
items.limitationEn: This is a narrative review and does not present new empirical data; recommendations are based on synthesizing existing literature.

items.title: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment
items.summary: This podcast explores AI's impact on physical therapy practice and payment, discussing its potential to reduce administrative tasks and improve patient care time.
items.curatedReason: AI 的影响已不限于理论，它正在实实在在地改变物理治疗的实践和支付模式。听完这期，你会明白 AI 如何减轻行政负担、优化工作流程，并最终让你有更多时间投入到患者护理中，这才是真正的价值所在。
items.titleZh: 探索人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响
items.titleEn: Exploring AI's Impact on Physical Therapist Practice and Payment | APTA
items.summaryZh: 这期播客探讨了人工智能对物理治疗执业和支付的影响，重点介绍了其在减轻行政负担、改进工作流程和增加患者护理时间方面的潜力，并汇集了行业领导者的见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: This podcast episode discusses how AI is impacting physical therapist practice and payment, focusing on reducing administrative burden, improving workflows, and enhancing patient care time, with insights from industry leaders.
items.limitation: 本期播客讨论了应用和误解，而非实证研究。
items.limitationEn: This is a podcast episode discussing applications and misconceptions, not empirical research.

items.title: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summary: Physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district report significant barriers to managing pelvic floor disorders, including inadequate training and resources, leading to infrequent patient care.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 地区的物理治疗师在处理盆底疾病（PFD）时面临的严重障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅。这意味着该地区患者很少能得到有效的 PFD 管理，凸显了资源和培训的迫切需求。
items.titleZh: 南非 uThukela 区公立医院物理治疗师管理盆底障碍的经验
items.titleEn: Experiences of physiotherapists in managing pelvic floor disorders at public hospitals in uThukela district, South Africa
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究揭示了南非 uThukela 区的物理治疗师在管理盆底障碍（PFDs）方面面临重大障碍，包括本科培训不足、人手短缺和转诊路径不畅，导致患者管理频率低下。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals that physiotherapists in South Africa's uThukela district face significant barriers in managing pelvic floor disorders (PFDs), including limited undergraduate training, understaffing, and poor referral pathways, resulting in infrequent patient management.
items.limitation: 研究集中于南非特定地区，限制了其推广性。
items.limitationEn: The study focused on a specific district in South Africa, limiting generalizability.
